subject.why: The small round cafe table, two curly white chairs, striped awning, and vase with a red rose are all clearly identifiable.

category.why: The environment should only consist of a clear ground strip at the bottom with open sky behind the hero object, but there is a wall and window structure filling the background.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The object is centrally placed with adequate margins around the top and sides, resting naturally on the ground strip.

colour.why: The palette is bright, warm, and juicy with clear separation between the foreground elements and the sky.

detail.why: The building wall and window behind the table are extra scenery props not requested in the brief.

style.why: The chunky, smooth 3D forms and satin sheen match the reference cards well.

fix: Remove the wall and window column behind the table and support the awning on slender posts so the table and chairs silhouette cleanly against the open sky.
